a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (operate to 8, then split) gives each of us only about a 4% chance to survive. The reserve holds just 4, enough to save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, because a random split would likely leave us both under 4. After that I'll operate every round so you can reach 4 too, and I won't take anything more. I know this breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator adds 2 per round for you. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours.
